answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks through proof-of-reputation anchoring: each agent's identity is anchored to verifiable historical behavior patterns and resource commitments. New identities must bootstrap trust by demonstrating competence on a reputation ridge—gradually gaining social capital through successful interactions. Sybil attackers face prohibitive costs as they cannot bootstrap multiple comet identities (fast-rising fake agents) without triggering anomaly detection systems that monitor acceleration patterns off the established trust ridge.
